scope: Five individual primary listing image concepts. No Shopify changes performed by this agent.
colours: Concept targets only; final supplier colour variants are not approved. Bone #E4DDCB tees; Slate #27303D pants; Ink/Rust on light fabric and Bone/Sun on dark.

construction_source.verified: Maker page confirms relaxed side-seamed fit, rib cuffs and waistband, natural-coloured flatcord, jersey-lined pockets and differential rise.

artwork: Canonical brand-system PNG art; Punched Out uses existing v2 preview-slate.png, not v3. AI concept artwork is approximate; canonical vector art remains authoritative.
review: All five outputs visually checked for single-garment composition, full edges, correct spellings, placement on wearer's left, colour relationships and cuffed pants. Targeted edits reduced initially oversized artwork and widened frame margins. Millimetre dimensions are intended visual scale, not production measurements.
